name: Hierarchical DDA / Multi-step DDA
definition: The process of converting ray parameters when entering a finer resolution sub-grid (second step) from a coarser voxel (first step), preserving inverse slopes to avoid recalculation.
summary: Hierarchical DDA optimizes ray traversal in huge voxel spaces by using a two-level grid hierarchy to skip empty coarse regions, differing from standard DDA by preserving inverse slopes across level boundaries.
